summary: The agent sets up a K-Fold cross-validation pipeline with LightGBM, but critically misconfigures the model by using a regression objective for a binary classification task. This fundamental mismatch (FM10) will also cause the evaluation metric to crash when computing log_loss on unbounded continuous predictions. Furthermore, the final model training will fail because an early stopping callback is used without providing a validation set, and the agent fails to perform any data cleaning or feature engineering.
